funFacts: Manchester City are the only team in the Premier League with a perfect 5-0-0 record (15 points).
Liverpool enter Matchweek 6 unbeaten on 9 points (2 wins, 3 draws).
This is the marquee fixture of Matchweek 6 as domestic football returns from the October break.

keyPlayers.name: Erling Haaland
keyPlayers.hook: Leads the Premier League scoring charts having found the net in all five matches.

keyPlayers.name: Mohamed Salah
keyPlayers.hook: Aims to halt City's flawless start before a raucous Anfield home crowd.

headToHead: Manchester City and Liverpool battle at Anfield in the defining showdown of Matchweek 6.
resultSummary: UPCOMING: Liverpool vs Manchester City · Sunday 16:30 BST, Anfield
headline: Premier League MW6: Liverpool host perfect Manchester City at Anfield
whyCareReason: After Arsenal's Saturday win drew them level on 15 points, Manchester City travel to Anfield needing a result to regain solo first place.
teaser: City have won five of five. Liverpool are unbeaten on nine points. Sunday 16:30 BST at Anfield is the weekend's blockbuster.
story: The Premier League reaches fever pitch on Sunday afternoon as Manchester City visit Anfield to battle Liverpool in Matchweek 6's marquee encounter. Arsenal's 2-1 victory over Leeds United on Saturday drew the Gunners level with City atop the table on 15 points, eliminating Pep Guardiola's margin for error. Liverpool have navigated a demanding opening stretch without defeat, recording two wins and three draws for 9 points. With Arne Slot's side possessing the league's stingiest defensive record and backed by a deafening Merseyside crowd, Sunday will determine whether City maintain their 100% start or surrender control of the title race.
stakes: A City victory extends their lead at the top of the table. A Liverpool win would pull the Reds within three points of the summit.
rivalryAngle: Modern English football's highest-caliber rivalry resumes with title momentum in the balance.
